items.subject: A sun-bleached outback cemetery of former Wittenoom workers and residents, rows of weathered headstones and plain metal grave markers
items.action: Dry wind moves across the rows, red dust settling on the newer stones at the end of the line
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction along the receding rows toward a flat horizon
items.setting: Small country cemetery in Western Australia's Pilbara, 1989, low wire fence, red earth, sparse spinifex
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, faded grey stone, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: A fresh mound of red earth beside a recently set headstone at the end of a long row
items.camera_angle: Eye-level, looking down the length of the rows
items.lighting: Soft late-afternoon golden light, long gentle shadows
items.mood: Still air, long shadows, rows stretching farther than the eye can follow
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y nueve ya habían muerto más de quinientos antiguos trabajadores y residentes de Wittenoom.

items.subject: Former asbestos workers and residents, Spanish-born and Anglo-Australian men and women in their forties to sixties, seen mostly from behind on folding chairs
items.action: They gather for the founding meeting of a victims' society, a thin man in his fifties standing near the front to speak, a grey-haired Spanish woman in a cardigan leaning toward a neighbour
items.gaze_interaction: Most face away toward the front table; the standing man's stooped shoulders and the oxygen-short pause of his posture carry the scene
items.setting: Modest Perth community hall, 1979, timber floor, fibro walls, louvred windows
items.color_palette: Faded cream walls, brown timber, muted 1970s browns and mustard
items.props_detail: A trestle table at the front with a hand-written sign-up sheet and a jug of water
items.camera_angle: Eye-level from the back of the hall
items.lighting: Soft daylight through louvred windows, warm and diffuse
items.mood: Quiet room, bowed heads, a group pressed shoulder to shoulder in the warm light
items.narration_anchor: Los que seguían vivos se habían juntado diez años antes en la Asbestos Diseases Society of Australia.

items.subject: A judge in robes at a high bench, small within a wood-panelled courtroom; former workers in the gallery, Anglo-Australian and Spanish-born men in their fifties and sixties, seen from behind
items.action: The judge reads the verdict aloud; in the gallery a heavy-set grey-haired man lowers his head, a thin man beside him sits upright with a hand on his chest
items.gaze_interaction: Gallery turned toward the bench; the judge's eyes down on the written judgment
items.setting: Supreme Court of Western Australia, Perth, 1988, dark timber panelling, raised bench, public gallery
items.color_palette: Deep brown timber, muted green upholstery, grey suits, pale window light
items.props_detail: The bound written judgment open on the bench under a brass reading lamp
items.camera_angle: Eye-level from the rear of the public gallery
items.lighting: Soft high window light falling across the bench, calm interior shade
items.mood: Hushed courtroom, a shaft of daylight on the bench, still backs in the gallery
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y ocho un juez leyó su veredicto: la compañía había mostrado un desprecio continuo, consciente y contumaz por la seguridad y la salud de sus trabajadores.

items.subject: A Spanish-born woman in her late sixties, slight build, grey hair pinned back, who lived in Wittenoom as a child
items.action: She lies on the table as it slides her into the CT scanner ring
items.gaze_interaction: Eyes on the ceiling, arms raised above her head, body very still
items.setting: Hospital imaging room in Perth, 2023, pale walls, observation window
items.color_palette: Clinical white, pale grey, soft blue-green gown
items.props_detail: The large white scanner ring she is sliding into
items.camera_angle: Eye-level, seen through the observation window from the control room
items.lens_technique: Deep depth of field, glass reflection in foreground
items.lighting: Soft diffuse clinical light mixed with daylight
items.mood: Hum of machinery, a small figure inside a large pale room, motionless body
items.narration_anchor: Mercedes de Juan, que se quedó en Australia, entra en un escáner y después sopla en un tubo.

items.subject: The same Spanish-born woman in her late sixties, slight build, lined weathered face, plain cardigan over a hospital gown
items.action: She blows hard into the mouthpiece tube of a lung function machine, nose clipped, shoulders lifting with the effort
items.gaze_interaction: Eyes forward toward the camera, cheeks drawn, posture leaning into the breath
items.setting: Respiratory clinic room in Perth, 2023, simple chair, window behind
items.color_palette: Soft white, pale grey, muted beige, warm window light
items.props_detail: Breathing tube connected to a spirometer on a small cart
items.lighting: Soft diffuse window daylight, gentle and even
items.mood: Quiet room, a single long breath pushed out, shoulders rising and sinking
items.narration_anchor: «Nos hacen un escáner y una prueba de función pulmonar», dice Mercedes.

items.subject: Chest X-ray films clipped to an illuminated lightbox, pale shadowing along the lung lining
items.action: The films glow on the wall in an empty consulting room
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction on the shadowed lung outlines
items.setting: Respiratory physician's consulting room, Perth, 2023, desk and empty chair below
items.color_palette: Cool grey-blue film tones, soft white glow, muted beige walls
items.props_detail: A row of chest X-ray films with clouded areas along the lungs
items.lighting: Backlit glow of the lightbox in a softly dim room
items.mood: Silent room, cool glow, the empty patient chair just out of focus
items.narration_anchor: Las fibras pueden causar mesotelioma, asbestosis y cáncer de pulmón.

items.subject: An advocacy office archive of asbestos victim case files, rows of cabinets and stacked archive boxes
items.action: Drawers stand open, files overflowing into boxes on the floor, the count still growing
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction down the aisle of cabinets toward a window
items.setting: Asbestos victims' society office in Perth, 2023, modest carpeted room
items.color_palette: Beige cabinets, brown archive boxes, pale walls, soft warm window light
items.props_detail: An open drawer packed with manila case folders, more boxes stacked beside it
items.mood: Quiet, dust motes in slanted light, paper filling every surface
items.narration_anchor: La cuenta oficial se detuvo. «El gobierno dejó de contar en 2.000, pero ahora se calcula que la cifra puede ser superior a los 4.000.

items.subject: A clinic waiting room with middle-aged Anglo-Australian men and women, sons and daughters of former town police and teachers; an Anglo-Australian advocate in her fifties stands by the window
items.action: A balding man in his fifties sits forward with elbows on knees, a woman in her late forties holds a referral envelope on her lap, the advocate looks out the window
items.gaze_interaction: Seated figures look down or away; the advocate turned toward the window
items.setting: Respiratory clinic waiting room, Perth, 2023, plain chairs along the wall
items.color_palette: Muted beige, pale blue chairs, soft warm daylight
items.props_detail: A large brown medical envelope resting on a lap
items.lighting: Soft diffuse daylight through tall windows
items.mood: Still room, bowed shoulders, a figure turned to the window light
items.narration_anchor: Y sigue aumentando», dice Melita Markey. Están enfermando hijos de policías y de maestros que trabajaron en el pueblo.

items.subject: The Wittenoom ghost town seen from above, deserted and partly demolished
items.action: Wind carries pale dust across empty streets and cleared lots where houses once stood
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction across the town toward the gorge and red ranges
items.setting: Wittenoom, Pilbara, 2006, abandoned grid of streets amid red desert hills
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, weathered grey roofs, hints of blue-grey tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: Bare concrete slabs of demolished houses scattered between the remaining buildings
items.lighting: Soft late-afternoon light, long low shadows
items.mood: Silence, emptiness spreading out to the horizon, gentle dust haze
items.narration_anchor: Mientras los enfermos se contaban a sí mismos, el Estado decidió qué hacer con el pueblo: borrarlo.

items.subject: A removed highway sign lying in the tray of a state road-crew utility truck; an Anglo-Australian road worker in his forties, sunburnt, stocky, dusty work shirt
items.action: The worker walks away from an empty sign post toward the truck, the town's name taken off the road
items.gaze_interaction: Worker seen from behind; the empty post and the sign in the tray are the focus
items.setting: Lonely bitumen highway turnoff in the Pilbara, June 2007, red earth verge, spinifex
items.color_palette: Red earth, faded green sign, white lettering, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: The old green road sign lying flat in the truck tray
items.mood: Open empty road, a bare post against a wide sky, heat shimmer on the horizon

text_in_image.location: on the removed sign lying in the truck tray

items.narration_anchor: Junio de dos mil siete; otras fuentes dicen dos mil seis. Wittenoom es abolido formalmente. Le quitan el nombre a las señales de la carretera y lo sacan de los mapas.

items.subject: Parliament House of Western Australia in Perth; a lone Anglo-Australian official in his fifties in a dark suit, small on the steps
items.action: The official descends the steps carrying the printed government statement
items.gaze_interaction: Figure seen from a distance, head lowered toward the papers
items.setting: Parliament House, Perth, 2007, sandstone facade, broad steps, lawns
items.color_palette: Warm sandstone, green lawns, dark suit, soft pale sky
items.props_detail: A thin folder of printed media statements under his arm
items.camera_angle: Low angle from the foot of the steps
items.lighting: Soft golden-hour light on the sandstone
items.mood: Calm evening light, a small figure against a large official facade
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de «el fin de un período oscuro en la historia de nuestro Estado».

items.subject: A bound parliamentary inquiry report recommending cleanup of the tailings, left on a long committee table
items.action: The report lies closed in an empty room after the session, chairs pushed back
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction along the polished table to the report at its end
items.setting: Parliamentary committee room, Perth, 1992, timber table, leather chairs, tall windows
items.color_palette: Dark polished timber, green leather, cream walls, soft grey light
items.props_detail: The thick bound report with a cream cover beside a half-empty water glass
items.camera_angle: Eye-level from the far end of the table
items.mood: Empty chairs, still air, a single document waiting in grey light
items.narration_anchor: Quince años antes, en mil novecientos noventa y dos, una investigación parlamentaria había recomendado limpiar los relaves. El gobierno rechazó esas recomendaciones.

items.subject: Mine tailings dumps spilling down the slopes of Wittenoom Gorge
items.action: The tailings lie heaped against the red gorge walls, wind skimming pale dust off their surface
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction up the gorge toward the abandoned mine workings
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge, Pilbara, 1994, steep banded red rock walls, dry creek bed
items.color_palette: Deep red rock, ochre, blue-grey tailings, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: A rusted ore chute jutting from the rock above the dumps
items.camera_angle: Low angle from the creek bed
items.lighting: Soft clear morning light raking the gorge walls
items.mood: Vast silent gorge, pale dust drifting in soft light, scale dwarfing everything
items.narration_anchor: «La minería en los desfiladeros ha dejado una contaminación que solo puede describirse como vergonzosa, incluso para los estándares de la época», dijo Larry Graham.

items.subject: Tailings along a dry creek bed below the gorge, washed out onto the floodplain
items.action: A wind gust lifts a pale plume of dust off the tailings and carries it down the creek toward a line of river gums
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction following the dust downstream toward the distant trees
items.setting: Floodplain below Wittenoom Gorge, Pilbara, 1992, dry creek bed, river red gums
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, blue-grey tailings, pale green gums, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A shallow rock pool in the creek bed with fine fibres along its edge
items.mood: Open floodplain, a drifting dust veil softening the sunlight
items.narration_anchor: «Tenemos el deber de impedir una mayor dispersión de los relaves de asbesto», dijo Mark Nevill, por los residentes, por los visitantes, por las generaciones futuras.

items.subject: A typed government memo on a desk weighing cleanup against cost
items.action: The memo lies under a desk lamp beside a cost table, a pen resting across it
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction on the typed page and its column of figures
items.setting: State government office in Perth, 2016, plain desk by a window
items.color_palette: White paper, grey desk, muted beige, soft warm lamp light
items.props_detail: A typed memo with a cost estimate table, unreadable at this distance
items.camera_angle: High angle looking down at the desk
items.lighting: Soft desk-lamp glow with gentle daylight from the window
items.mood: Quiet office, warm lamp light on paper, an empty chair pushed in
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil dieciséis, los documentos dicen por qué los relaves siguen donde están: no porque no se pueda, sino por lo que cuesta.

items.subject: An elderly Aboriginal Australian man of about seventy, thin frame, slightly stooped, faded work shirt, standing at a barricade on the road into the former town
items.action: He stands at the closed barrier as wind drives pale dust across the road and past the warning sign toward him
items.gaze_interaction: Body turned three-quarters toward the camera, eyes forward, one hand resting on the barrier rail
items.setting: Barricaded access road to the former Wittenoom townsite, Pilbara, 2023, red ranges behind
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, faded yellow warning sign, blue-grey dust haze, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A weathered warning sign bolted to the barrier, old tyre tracks fading in the dust
items.lighting: Soft golden-hour light through drifting dust
items.mood: Wide open land, warm low light, dust moving past a still figure at the barrier

text_in_image.location: on the warning sign attached to the barrier

items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintitrés, los estudios del Estado sobre hasta dónde llega la contaminación ya estaban desactualizados. Borraron el nombre del mapa. El polvo no leía mapas.
